title: Software Development Engineer II, AFT Sortation, AFT Mansort
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Have you ever wondered how Amazon delivers millions of customer orders with exceptional speed and reliability? Behind every fast and on-time delivery is a complex network of software, infrastructure, robotics, and operational processes engineered to work seamlessly at scale.  
  
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) builds the software and infrastructure that power Amazon's world-class fulfillment centers. Our systems integrate with warehouse automation, machines, and human associates to orchestrate critical fulfillment processes across a global network. These technologies enable the movement of millions of inventory units and support billions of transactions, ensuring that customers receive the products they want, when they expect them.  
  
About the Mansort Team  
  
The Mansort team owns the manual sortation layer of Amazon's fulfillment network. Our systems determine where packages should be routed after packing and before reaching the outbound dock, enabling accurate and efficient movement of shipments through fulfillment centers.  
  
We build and operate software responsible for sort plan generation, chute and destination assignment, and scan-and-sort workflows used by warehouse associates. Our systems operate on the fulfillment center floor across hundreds of buildings worldwide, where reliability, performance, and correctness directly influence operational efficiency and customer delivery promises.  
  
Mansort operates in a technically demanding environment characterized by high transaction volumes, stringent low-latency requirements, and the need for continuous availability despite connectivity disruptions or upstream dependency failures. Correctness is equally critical: every sortation decision must accurately direct a package to its intended destination to prevent operational errors and missed transportation cutoffs.  
  
Manual sortation complements Amazon's automated sortation capabilities by providing the flexibility and scalability needed to handle peak demand, support new geographies and fulfillment center formats, and accommodate diverse operational requirements that cannot always be addressed through fixed automation.  
  
As Amazon continues to expand its global fulfillment network and introduce new supply chain capabilities, delivery models, and customer experiences, the Mansort team has an opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems, modernize existing systems, and build scalable, resilient solutions that support the future of fulfillment operations.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Design and develop scalable systems by owning the architecture, design, implementation, testing, and deployment of distributed software systems operating in live fulfillment center environments.  
  
Build high-throughput, low-latency services that meet stringent performance, scalability, and availability requirements.  
  
Ensure operational reliability and correctness through robust sortation workflows, data integrity, routing accuracy, fault tolerance, and graceful degradation.  
  
Solve complex business and technical problems using pragmatic engineering decisions, innovative solutions, and modern technologies.  
  
Drive operational excellence by improving observability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and recovery mechanisms to minimize disruptions.  
  
Collaborate with product managers, operations teams, process engineers, and partner engineering teams to improve fulfillment efficiency and customer experience.  
  
Influence technical direction by contributing to architecture, engineering standards, and technical strategy within the team and broader organization.  
  
Maintain high engineering standards by writing clean, maintainable, well-tested code and ensuring software quality, performance, security, and reliability.  
  
Mentor engineers through knowledge sharing, design discussions, code reviews, and technical guidance to strengthen team capabilities.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
Outer Ring Road, Building Willow-L2 Manyata Embassy Business Park, SEZ, Location Bengaluru 1499 Category Corporate Job Id JR-02660102 Job Type Full time

  

JOB DESCRIPTION

**Innovate in Bengaluru**

This position is based at our on-site office in Bengaluru. Lowe's offers an ultramodern work environment, complete with cutting-edge technology, collaborative workspaces, an on-site gym and clinic, and other perks to enhance your work experience.

  

**About Lowe’s**

Lowe’s is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week in the United States. With total fiscal year 2024 sales of more than $83 billion, Lowe’s operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com.

  

Lowe’s India, the Global Capability Center of Lowe’s Companies Inc., is a hub for driving our technology, business, analytics, and shared services strategy. Based in Bengaluru with over 4,500 associates, it powers innovations across omnichannel retail, AI/ML, enterprise architecture, supply chain, and customer experience. From supporting and launching homegrown solutions to fostering innovation through its Catalyze platform, Lowe’s India plays a pivotal role in transforming home improvement retail while upholding strong commitment to social impact and sustainability. For more information, visit Lowes India

  

**About the Team**

The Order-to-Cash (O2C) Credit & Collections team plays a critical role in managing the company's cash flow and minimizing credit risk. The team is responsible for evaluating customer creditworthiness, monitoring accounts receivable, resolving payment disputes, and driving timely collections while maintaining strong customer relationships. Working closely with Sales, Customer Service, Finance, and Operations, the team ensures efficient cash application, dispute resolution, and adherence to company credit policies. Our focus is on improving working capital, reducing bad debt exposure, and delivering an excellent customer experience throughout the receivables lifecycle.

  

**Job Summary:**

A Collections Representative plays an important role in supporting the company’s financial objectives by effectively managing assigned customer accounts and driving timely resolution of outstanding receivables.

The role is responsible for reviewing and analyzing individual accounts, determining the most appropriate collection strategy, proactively engaging with customers, and executing follow-up actions to maximize cash recovery while maintaining positive customer relationships.

The ideal candidate should be customer-focused, results-oriented, adaptable, and comfortable working in a dynamic team environment where priorities and account assignments may change frequently. Strong communication, problem-solving, negotiation, and ownership skills are essential for success in this role.

  
  

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Core Responsibilities:**·

Manage a specific portfolio of accounts

Maintain records of contacts and attempted contacts with delinquent accounts as well as records of any payments collected.

Contact customers with overdue accounts

Initiate the dispute process on disputed invoices, or misapplications

Negotiate payment agreements within their designated level of authority

Make judgment decisions regarding the status of a customer account based on thorough analysis of the customer’s purchases, payments, history, ability to pay and our business strategy.

Maintain strong communication with Outside Sales Representatives, Customer Service and Leadership

Release orders

Soft collections

  
  

**Years of Experience:**

2-3 Years in O2C with Collections experience must.

  
  

**Education Qualification & Certifications**

**Required Minimum Qualifications**:

Bachelors Degree / Post Graduate Degree

  
  

**Skill Set Required Primary Skills (must have)**

Strong understanding of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes, with a solid knowledge of the overall receivable’s lifecycle

Hands-on experience in Collections and Accounts Receivable (AR) management, including customer follow-ups, past-due management, and account resolution.

Shift Requirement: Must be comfortable working U.S.-aligned night shifts:

6:30 PM – 3:30 AM IST during Daylight Saving Time (DST)

7:30 PM – 4:30 AM IST when Daylight Saving Time is not in effect.

  

**Secondary Skills (desired)**·

Strong understanding of the end-to-end Order-to-Cash (OTC) process, including Account Setup, Credit Management, Collections, and Cash Application.

OTC Systems & Tools: Experience with Cforia, Billtrust, High Radius,

Lien Tracking via NCS would be an added advantage.

Familiarity with these platforms and their application within the Order-to-Cash lifecycle is preferred.· · ·
